subject: planner: Fix mpp join column prune added projection incorrect construction (#52943)
summary: Reviewed commit diff (first-parent) in `pkg/planner/core/task.go` for `PhysicalHashJoin.attach2TaskForMpp`. The change adjusts the injected projection (used to counter TiFlash Join schema mismatch after column pruning) to add missing MPP hash-partition columns by sourcing the corresponding `*expression.Column` from `defaultSchema` (the join output schema) and cloning into the projection schema, with a guard to only add columns present in `defaultSchema`. This addresses incorrect column construction/type metadata when `task.hashCols` columns were not in the pruned join schema. No Blocker/High issues found in this commit; no subsequent commits up to `origin/master` modify this file.
